title: Helm of Arcane Gate

sources.title: Arcane Gate
markers: | description = Create two linked teleportation portals within range. All creatures, including enemies, may travel between the two portals as a free action.

summary: An unobtainable helmet that can cast Arcane Gate.

fields.Arcane Gate: Action once per Long Rest. Choose two points within 60 ft. The portals last 10 turns with concentration. Any creature, including enemies, can pass between them freely.
fields.Base value: 95 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
